Genuine 2025+ FOREIGN buy-side demand for Iranian/snack pistachios lives almost entirely on gated B2B lead boards (TradeKey, go4WorldBusiness), where a large share of 'buyers' are anonymous handles, first-names-only, or templated boilerplate that reads AI-generated and cannot be independently verified; most contacts sit behind premium paywalls. products.product_read: Moderate overall, but thin where it actually counts for an Iranian exporter. Verifiable 2025-2026 foreign buy-side demand clearly exists, but it splits into (a) genuine yet non-addressable Western/EU/US public procurement (HACLA-US, Sprava zeleznic-CZ, Thulamela-ZA) blocked by sanctions or local-vendor registration rules, and (b) a smaller set of realistically addressable GCC/CIS channels - Qatar sanitary-ware import leads on B2B marketplaces (go4WorldBusiness) and Russia developer tile tenders (b2b-center) - where buyer identity is anonymized or platform-gated. Aggregator-only listings (BidDetail: Belarus/Kazakhstan) could not be independently confirmed on native portals and were dropped. Best genuine, addressable 2025+ demand sits in Qatar/GCC marketplace buy-leads and Russia/CIS platform tenders.
